effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] By placing 1 of your other Digimon with the [DigiPolice] trait as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[Your Turn] This Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack.
